apps.name: Zone Alert
apps.subtitle: Heart-rate zone alerts for your Polar strap
apps.localizedDescription: Pairs with your Polar H9 over Bluetooth and alerts you (buzz + banner) when your heart rate drops below your Zone 2 floor or rises above your Zone 3 ceiling — even with the screen locked. Includes a live workout dashboard, daily/weekly progress, and a VO2 Max test.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Connects to your heart-rate strap to track zones and alert you, even when the screen is locked.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Measures your distance and pace during a workout.
privacy.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Keeps recording distance and pace while the screen is locked.
privacy.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Reads your all-day steps, resting heart rate, and sleep from Apple Health.
privacy.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Can save your completed workouts to Apple Health.
